name: Heritage Park Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Blue, White. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: holes 1, 2, 10, 11, 12: wrong routing; 1 more with a wrong tee or pick

1: MISSING on the page. Hole 1 is the OSM tee boxes way/930838113-115 (centroids 354/310/284 yds; the back box measures 371 along its axis) -> OSM green way/930838116 (card 368/337/308/282).
2: The page's hole 2 is really hole 11 (tees way/930838171-172 -> green way/930838176; the four boxes there measure 224/192/158/98 = hole 11's 227/193/157/98 exactly).
5: CHECK hole. Blue tee is a lidar pad 22 yds from the OSM back box way/930838135, which measures 623 to the green (card 629); the box is the better tee. Yardage barely changes, routing OK, driver to the fairway OK.
7: CHECK hole. Routing OK (OSM tees 147-149 -> green 151).
9: CHECK hole. Routing OK (OSM tees 160-161 -> green 164). The OSM boxes measure 461/425 (card Red 462); Blue 517 / White 494 are not mapped.
10: The page's 'hole 10' is really hole 1 (green way/930838116).
11: MISSING on the page. Par 3: OSM tees way/930838170-173 (224/192/158/98) -> green way/930838176 (card 227/193/157/98). The page showed this hole as 'hole 2'.
12: The page's 'hole 12' is really hole 10. Hole 12 is OSM tees way/930838177-179 (393/344/314 = card Blue 395 / Red 346 / Silver 314) -> green way/930838182 (the green the build left unassigned).
18: CHECK hole. Routing OK (OSM tees 528-531 -> green 535). OSM boxes measure 494/467/439/421 vs card 539/511/483/469: the card is ~45 yds longer than every box.
